description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates a profile's (booking page) configuration. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId} (JSON, partial update). Pass the fields to change via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. { title, subdomain, ... }) — profile fields are numerous and use YCBM's own names. The path id is never sent in the body.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id to update (path only; required).

name: update_profile
title: Update a profile (booking page)
